meta.title: Cross-lab strategy leaderboard aggregation and measured correlations
meta.rule: One rule for the whole board: rank by gates passed, then by ROI. Positive ROI alone earns nothing; every lab's qualified count is zero as of this capture.
meta.method: Rows are read from the committed JSON of each lab (paths in source_file); the published leaderboard page for each lab is linked from its source row. Controls (skill-lab STR-16) are excluded from reward consideration.

leaderboard.top_result: S6 · Divisional home underdog — 5/10 gates, ROI -1.21% (n=137)
leaderboard.ranking_rule: Rank by gates passed, then ROI; reward only at 10/10 (Tier 1), paper-trade at 8-9 with G9 (Tier 2)

leaderboard.top_result: S5 · Model edge — 3/6 gates (best of five)
leaderboard.ranking_rule: Six pre-registered gates: sample, significance, BH multiple-testing, positive-after-vig CI, stability, cost
Ten gates incl. deflated Sharpe, permutation p, BH q=0.10, season-block bootstrap CI

leaderboard.top_result: Top of board: S11 wind-under (0 of 18 eligible for rewards)
leaderboard.ranking_rule: Eligibility requires the lab's full gate set; 0 eligible

leaderboard.top_result: S10 · Wind 15+ under — 6/9 gates, holdout ROI +3.83% (p=0.174); 0 of 21 pass all nine
leaderboard.ranking_rule: Discovery 2002-2019 / holdout 2020-2026 split; FDR q=0.10; nine gates incl. worst-LOSO and concentration

leaderboard.top_result: Best non-control: STR-08 2-leg wind-under parlay, ROI +34.9% but luck-adjusted -3.9%; 0 qualified, pool 10,000 points (unfunded)
leaderboard.ranking_rule: 10/10 gates + Skill Score >=75 (Gold) or >=60 (Silver); controls excluded from rewards

correlations.pair: QB passing yards vs WR1 receiving yards (same team, same game)
correlations.note: Core same-game-parlay pair: same passing volume drives both legs.

correlations.pair: QB passing yards vs that game's top receiver (ex-post leader)
correlations.note: Near-duplicates; the receiver is the game's yards leader, not a pregame choice.

correlations.pair: Top-two receivers' yards, holding team passing volume constant
correlations.note: The residual 'positive correlation' a market SGP prices when pairing two receivers.

correlations.pair: Home QB vs away QB passing yards (same game)
correlations.note: Pace/shootout coupling — the one useful positive cross-team correlation.

correlations.pair: A player's own receptions vs own receiving yards (same game)
correlations.note: Same player, two props — effectively one leg priced twice.

correlations.pair: Home ATS result vs game total (same game)
correlations.note: Settlement-level independence for cross-market same-game parlays.
The two prices are quoted almost independently.

correlations.pair: Home points vs away points (pace coupling)
correlations.note: Weak negative coupling; significant only because n is large.
Margin and total are close to orthogonal.

correlations.pair: Lead RB rushing yards vs team passing yards (same game)
correlations.note: Game script: trailing teams abandon the run.

correlations.pair: Home ATS cover <-> game total over (skill-lab)
correlations.note: Binary phi 0.0124; parlaying spread + over indiscriminately adds double vig with no correlation edge.

correlations.pair: Home favorite cover (-3.5+) <-> game total over (skill-lab)
correlations.note: Small but significant positive link on the favorite subset.
